description: This file defines the Perl module Git::SVN::Ra, which wraps and extends the SVN::Ra module to support git-svn functionalities. It includes class methods for managing SVN repositories, caching, handling version incompatibilities, and performing repositories operations like checkout, switch, and log retrieval.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl module extending SVN::Ra with additional capabilities and customizations for git-svn.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new Git::SVN::Ra object for a given URL, initializing SVN::Ra with configuration and caching.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks the existence and type of a path in the repository, with caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries at a given path and revision, with caching support.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Retrieves commit logs for given paths, handling version differences and wrapping the SVN::Ra's get_log.

methods.name: do_switch
methods.description: Performs a switch operation to change the target URL of a working copy.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Executes an update on the repository working copy.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Performs an SVN switch to a different URL, handling repository reparenting.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Computes the longest common directory path among given git-svn glob objects and optional glob patterns.

methods.name: match_globs
methods.description: Matches given SVN paths against a set of glob patterns and returns matched Git::SVN objects.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Returns a more concise URL representation relative to the repository root.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles specific SVN error codes to skip unknown revisions without failing.

methods.name: is_ref_ignored
methods.description: Checks if a reference path matches ignore regex patterns.

methods.name: prepare_config_once
methods.description: Initializes configuration for SVN authentication and caches the setup.
